articles.summary: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) allows advancement of RAP-219 into registrational trials for focal onset seizures (FOS); accelerated initiation of Phase 3 program expected in the second quarter of 2026 On strength of RAP-219 Phase 2a FOS data, epilepsy portfolio expanded with new program
articles.title: Rapport Therapeutics Announces Accelerated Initiation of RAP-219 Phase 3 Program, Expansion of Epilepsy Portfolio, and Continued Progress Across the Pipeline
